name: hooks-subagent-model
description: Model-routing deny gate for subagent spawns. A PreToolUse:Agent hook DENIES an Agent/Task call when `model` is omitted AND the named subagent_type has no pinned model in its definition (or subagent_type itself is omitted) — the spawn would otherwise silently inherit the parent session's model, often an expensive top-tier one. The deny reason is a tier routing table (cheap tier for mechanical work, mid tier for bounded coding/research, top tier or an explicit session-model pass-through for deep/adversarial work) so the caller's retry succeeds. The deny reason also notes that reasoning effort is NOT enforceable per-call (no `effort` field exists on the Agent tool_input) and points to pinning `effort:` in reusable agent definitions instead. The inherit-by-default type list is overridable per-project via SUBAGENT_MODEL_GUARD_INHERIT_TYPES. Fails open on malformed input. Claude-only (the Agent spawn tool is Claude-specific); the Codex variant is a no-op.
